---
title: "Research"
---

My research focuses on shock waves and compressible flows.

## Research Interests

- Shock waves
- Compressible flow
- Shock–turbulence interaction
- Shock-wave/boundary-layer interaction
- Experimental fluid dynamics
- Computational fluid dynamics


## Research Topics

### Shock Wave Attenuation

Investigating the modulation and attenuation of shock waves through interactions with porous surfaces and complex geometries.

### Shock-Turbulence Interaction

Understanding how shock waves interact with turbulent flows through numerical simulations and experiments.

### Shock-Wave/Boundary-Layer Interaction

Exploring the physics and control of shock-wave/boundary-layer interactions in high-speed flows.
